name: bioguard
description: Build orchestration for the Vercel deployment. The application itself lives in web/ and server/, each with its own package.json and lockfile — this file deliberately declares no dependencies, so the Docker build in the root Dockerfile is unaffected by its existence. "type": "module" is load-bearing: it is the nearest package.json to api/, so it decides whether Vercel compiles the function as ESM or CommonJS, and the server build it imports is ESM.

scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix server ci --include=dev && npm --prefix web ci --include=dev && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
